# Dromo

Dromo is an intuitive spreadsheet importer that integrates seamlessly with your product, enabling users to match columns, correct errors, perform complex validations, transform values, and upload perfectly formatted data.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dromo/.

## Actions

- **List Uploads** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all uploads stored by dromo for your organization.
- **Upload File To Headless Import**: Upload a file to a headless import.
